verdict.rationale: Finix says more than 10 automated report types (transactions, disputes, fees) are available in the dashboard, and resources such as disputes are accessible via API. This gives some route to pulling data out. However, nothing documents a full-account export, open file formats, or an exit or offboarding path. The only migration docs cover moving data into Finix, not out. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full data export, explicit open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), portability of stored card or tokenized data to another processor, a documented offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
